title: Matrix row-maximum menu
statement: Process matrix-menu commands. R replaces the matrix and X prints the maximum value from every row. A query before the first read must print EMPTY.
input_format: The first line contains q (1 <= q <= 30). R is followed by rows, columns, and all matrix values; X requests row maxima. Commands are case-insensitive.
output_format: For each X command print all row maxima on one line or EMPTY. Print INVALID for an unknown command.
